title: Eigenvalue Distribution of $p$-adic Random Matrices Among Algebraic Extensions, with an Analogue for $p$-adic Random Polynomials
summary: We study the distribution of eigenvalues of Haar-random matrices over $\mathbb{Z}_p$ among algebraic extensions of $\mathbb{Q}_p$. Our results give $p$-adic analogues of the real-eigenvalue counting results of Edelman-Kostlan-Shub for the real Ginibre ensemble, but with a different degree behavior: while real eigenvalues form only a vanishing proportion in the real Ginibre ensemble, $p$-adic eigenvalues are asymptotically evenly distributed among possible extension degrees.
